faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Foster City?
faq.answer: Foster City homeowners typically invest $6,000 to $14,000 for a full window replacement project. This planned San Mateo County community features 1970s–1980s homes on the Bay shoreline that frequently need upgrades to combat salt air and coastal wind exposure. Projects covering 10–16 windows are typical. Single window installation starts at approximately $560.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Foster City?
faq.answer: Yes. Foster City requires a building permit for window replacements. HOA requirements may also apply in many of Foster City's planned residential communities. Our team manages all permit applications and HOA submittals on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Foster City?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Foster City commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Foster City?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Foster City replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Foster City?
faq.answer: Most Foster City projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
